name: GLI Certification Submission Checklist
description: Complete checklist for submitting a slot game to GLI (or equivalent lab) for GLI-11/GLI-19 certification. Based on official GLI submission requirements.

items.description: CSPRNG algorithm name, version, and implementation source
Seed management mechanism (entropy source, seed length >= 256 bits, update strategy)
Spin independence guarantee documentation
NIST SP 800-22 statistical test results (>= 1M samples, all p-value > 0.01)
Complete RNG module source code
Diehard test results (supplementary evidence)
Theoretical RTP derivation with all symbol combinations and probabilities
RTP contribution breakdown (base game, free spins, bonus, multiplier, progressive)
Monte Carlo simulation results (>= 10M spins, RTP convergence curve)
Variance analysis (theoretical vs simulated RTP, error < 0.5%)
Complete RTP calculation spreadsheet (Excel or equivalent)
Multi-bet-level RTP verification (confirm RTP invariant across bet amounts)
Game overview (reel config, paylines, bet range)
Spin Lifecycle 6-stage detailed description
Rule engine: Wild substitution, Payline matching, Scatter triggers, Multiplier application
Bonus features: trigger conditions, operation logic, retrigger rules
Game state transition diagram (base game - free spin - bonus round)
Boundary conditions: max win cap, multi-feature priority order
All symbol definitions (name, category, visual reference)
Complete reel strip sequences and virtual reel weight tables
Payout multiplier table (all combinations for 3/4/5 match)
Probability calculation for each winning combination
Cross-validation of paytable payouts vs RTP calculation
Deposit/betting limits UI flow and implementation
Self-exclusion mechanism (pause and permanent stop)
Session time reminder trigger conditions and display
Net win/loss tracking display and update frequency
RTP percentage and risk message display
Autoplay controls (market-specific restrictions)
UI screenshots or wireframes for all RG features
Network disconnection recovery mechanism
Server failure game state preservation and recovery
Concurrent conflict handling (multi-device same account)
Fund anomaly detection and correction mechanism
RNG failure safe-stop mechanism
Complete error code list with player-facing messages
Transaction rollback process
JSON structure definition with all required fields
Field descriptions (data type, requirement level, purpose)
At least 3 complete log examples (win, no-win, bonus trigger)
Storage strategy (retention period, encryption, access control)
Query interface for regulatory audit access
